rows.ja: 供給元(材料・部品・通信)
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: カスタム半導体と無線接続技術の設計・製造で複数年のコミットメント
relations.text_en: Multiyear commitment with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon and wireless connectivity

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple today announced a new multiyear commitment with Broadcom to design and produce custom silicon components and cutting-edge wireless connectivity technologies for a wide range of Apple products. The new agreement, expected to exceed $30 billion

relations.text: 米国での半導体製造を増やす契約
relations.text_en: Agreement to bring more semiconductor manufacturing to the U.S. at the Malta, New York fab

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: GlobalFoundries and Apple have also entered an agreement to bring more semiconductor manufacturing to the United States

relations.text: テキサス州オースティン工場で、Apple向けの新しいチップ製造技術を立ち上げる協業
relations.text_en: Working with Samsung at its Austin, Texas fab to launch a new chip-making technology for Apple products

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple is also working with Samsung at its fab in Austin, Texas, to launch an innovative new technology for making chips

relations.text: アリゾナ工場がApple向けに数千万個のチップを生産。Appleが最初で最大の顧客
relations.text_en: TSMC’s Arizona fab is producing tens of millions of chips for Apple, its first and largest customer

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: TSMC in Arizona, which is producing tens of millions of chips for Apple using one of the most advanced process technologies in America. Apple is this factory’s first and largest customer

relations.text: 米国の半導体製造装置の生産を増やすため、Applied Materialsと直接提携
relations.text_en: Partnering directly with Applied Materials to boost U.S. production of semiconductor manufacturing equipment

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple is also partnering directly with Applied Materials to boost the production of semiconductor manufacturing equipment in the U.S.

relations.text: Amkorの2025年売上の29.8%がAppleへの直接販売
relations.text_en: Direct sales to Apple were 29.8% of Amkor’s 2025 net sales

source.label: Amkor 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Direct sales to Apple and Qualcomm accounted for 29.8% and 11.1% of our net sales, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2025.

relations.text: Qualcommが年次報告で、2025年度の売上の10%以上を占める顧客・ライセンス先の1社としてAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Qualcomm’s annual report lists Apple among customers/licensees each accounting for 10% or more of fiscal 2025 revenues

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In fiscal 2025, revenues from Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenues.

relations.text: Cirrusの2026年度売上の約91%が、Appleという1社の最終顧客
relations.text_en: Apple accounted for about 91% of Cirrus Logic’s fiscal 2026 net sales.

source.label: Cirrus Logic 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: we had one end customer, Apple Inc., who purchased through multiple contract manufacturers and represented approximately 91 percent
source.note: Cirrusの売上全体に対する割合です。
source.note_en: Percentage is of Cirrus Logic’s total net sales.

relations.text: iPhoneとApple Watchのカバーガラスをすべて、ケンタッキー州ハロッズバーグのCorning工場で製造する25億ドルのコミットメント
relations.text_en: $2.5B commitment to produce all iPhone and Apple Watch cover glass at Corning’s Harrodsburg, Kentucky facility

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple is committing $2.5 billion to produce all of the cover glass for iPhone and Apple Watch in Corning’s Harrodsburg, Kentucky, manufacturing facility

relations.text: 米国産のレアアース磁石を購入する、5億ドルの複数年契約
relations.text_en: $500M multiyear deal to buy American-made rare earth magnets from MP Materials

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Today Apple announced a new commitment of $500 million with MP Materials, the only fully integrated rare earth producer in the United States

relations.text: Face ID用のVCSELレーザーの供給で、新たな複数年契約
relations.text_en: New multiyear agreement with Coherent, supplier of VCSEL lasers used for Face ID

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple has also entered into a new multiyear agreement with Coherent, a long-standing partner that produces the VCSEL lasers that enable multiple features — including Face ID

relations.text: TDKは長年の供給元で、米国で初めてApple向けのセンサーを製造
relations.text_en: Calls TDK a longtime supplier that will manufacture sensors for Apple in the U.S. for the first time

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Longtime Apple supplier TDK will manufacture sensors for Apple in the U.S. for the very first time.

relations.text: Appleへ、サービス契約にもとづき衛星の通信容量を卸売で提供
relations.text_en: Provides wholesale satellite capacity services to Apple under service agreements

source.label: Globalstar 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We provide certain services to Apple Inc. (the "Customer") pursuant to a service agreement and certain related ancillary agreements

relations.text: 次世代のApple Foundation ModelsをGoogleのGeminiを基盤にする複数年の協業
relations.text_en: Multi-year collaboration: next-generation Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google’s Gemini

source.label: Google ブログ: Joint statement from Google and Apple
source.label_en: Google blog: Joint statement from Google and Apple
source.quote: Apple and Google have entered into a multi-year collaboration under which the next generation of Apple Foundation Models will be based on Google's Gemini models and cloud technology.

relations.text: Apple製品でGoogle検索を提供するライセンスの収入を得ていると記載
relations.text_en: Earns revenue from licensing arrangements with Google to offer Google search on Apple platforms

source.label: Apple 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Company earns revenue from licensing arrangements with Google LLC (“Google”) and other companies to offer their search services on the Company’s platforms and applications
source.note: 米司法省の訴訟の判決や控訴の影響を受けます。
source.note_en: Subject to the DOJ v. Google remedies order and appeal.

relations.text: Apple IntelligenceにChatGPT(GPT-4o)を統合(iOS 18・macOS Sequoiaなど、2024年6月10日)
relations.text_en: Announced ChatGPT (GPT-4o) integration into Apple Intelligence across iOS 18, iPadOS 18 and macOS Sequoia

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: ChatGPT will come to iOS 18, iPadOS 18, and macOS Sequoia later this year, powered by GPT-4o.
source.note: 利用者が有効にするかを選べます。
source.note_en: Users choose whether to enable the integration.

relations.text: Xcode 26.3が、AnthropicのClaude Agentによるエージェント型コーディングに対応
relations.text_en: Xcode 26.3 supports agentic coding with Anthropic’s Claude Agent

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Xcode 26.3 introduces support for agentic coding, a new way in Xcode for developers to build apps using coding agents such as Anthropic’s Claude Agent and OpenAI’s Codex.
source.note: 開発ツールへの統合で、モデルの供給契約ではありません。
source.note_en: A developer-tool integration, not a model-supply deal.

relations.text: Apple Cardの新しい発行会社になると発表
relations.text_en: Announced it will become the new issuer of Apple Card

source.label: JPMorgan Chase 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On January 7, 2026, JPMorganChase announced that Chase will become the new issuer of Apple Card.
source.note: 取引の完了が条件です。

relations.text: Spotifyが年次報告で、競合として機器に自社サービスを事前搭載する企業の1社にAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Spotify’s annual report names Apple among competitors with devices that preload competing audio services

source.label: Spotify 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our competitors, including Apple, Alphabet, and Amazon, have developed, and are continuing to develop, devices for which their audio streaming services are preloaded

relations.text: Garminが年次報告で、フィットネス・アウトドア製品の主な競合としてAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Garmin’s annual report lists Apple among its principal competitors in fitness and outdoor products

source.label: Garmin 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Garmin believes that its principal competitors for fitness products are Apple, Bryton, Coros

relations.text: Rokuが年次報告で、競合するTV向けストリーミング端末を出す企業としてAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Roku’s annual report says Apple offers TV streaming devices that compete with Roku devices

source.label: Roku 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Large companies such as Amazon, Apple, and Google offer TV streaming devices that compete with Roku streaming devices

relations.text: AppleとTexas Instrumentsが提携を拡大し、Appleが米国内の生産能力を支える新たなコミットメントを表明
relations.text_en: Apple and Texas Instruments are expanding their partnership with a new Apple commitment supporting U.S. capacity

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple and Texas Instruments are expanding their partnership to increase future product collaboration and critical U.S. capacity for this work.

relations.text: テキサス州ShermanのGlobalWafers Americaと提携し、米国の工場向け先端ウエハーを生産
relations.text_en: Apple is partnering with GlobalWafers America in Sherman, Texas to produce advanced wafers for U.S.-based fabs

source.label: Apple ニュースルーム
source.quote: Apple is partnering with GlobalWafers America in Sherman, Texas, to produce advanced wafers for use in U.S.-based semiconductor fabs for the first time.
source.note: 相手は子会社のGlobalWafers Americaです。
source.note_en: The partner is GlobalWafers America, a subsidiary.

relations.text: Skyworksが年次報告で、主要顧客の1社としてAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Skyworks lists Apple among its key customers

source.label: Skyworks 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our key customers include Amazon, Apple Inc.

relations.text: Goldman SachsがApple Cardのカード発行元。2025年12月に別の発行会社へ移行する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Goldman Sachs currently issues Apple Card and agreed in December 2025 to transition the program to another issuer

source.label: Goldman Sachs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2025, we entered into an agreement to transition the Apple Card program to another issuer.
source.note: 移行にはおよそ24か月かかる見込みです。
source.note_en: The transition is expected to take about 24 months.

relations.text: Snapが年次報告で、競合する企業の1社としてAppleを挙げている
relations.text_en: Snap’s annual report names Apple among companies it competes with

source.label: Snap 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: such as Alphabet (including Google and YouTube), Apple, ByteDance (TikTok and affiliated joint ventures), Meta (including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp), Pinterest

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
